correctness.description:
Test `test_zammad_api_accessible` passes: Test 1: Verify Zammad API is running
Purpose: Validates environment setup

Test `test_ticket_5_exists` passes: Test 2: Verify prerequisite ticket exists
Purpose: Confirms test data setup

Test `test_script_executes_successfully` passes: Test 3: Verify script runs without errors
Purpose: Tests basic execution

Test `test_output_format_correct` passes: Test 4: Verify output matches specification
Purpose: Tests output formatting

Test `test_title_matches_ticket` passes: Test 5: Verify correct title is printed
Purpose: Validates title extraction

Test `test_state_matches_ticket` passes: Test 6: Verify correct state is printed
Purpose: Validates state extraction

Test `test_uses_environment_credentials` passes: Test 7: Verify script uses env variables for auth
Purpose: Tests proper authentication setup

functional.description: The solution uses the Zammad API endpoint 'http://localhost:8080' (or 'http://zammad:8080')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct Zammad instance

functional.description: The solution authenticates using HTTP Basic Auth with credentials from environment variables
functional.rationale: Authentication is required for API access; environment variables are the standard way to provide credentials.

functional.description: The solution fetches ticket details using the GET /api/v1/tickets/{id} endpoint
functional.rationale: Using the correct API endpoint is essential for retrieving ticket information.

robustness.description: The solution checks for the existence of required environment variables before execution
robustness.rationale: Prevents runtime failures by validating configuration early.

robustness.description: The solution handles HTTP 404 responses (Ticket Not Found) gracefully
robustness.rationale: Ensures the script reports a missing ticket clearly instead of crashing.

robustness.description: The solution handles general HTTP request exceptions (e.g., connection errors)
robustness.rationale: Prevents the script from crashing due to network issues.

robustness.description: The solution handles non-200 status codes (other than 404) by printing an error message
robustness.rationale: Ensures API errors (e.g., 500, 401) are reported to the user.
